availability.freshnessNote: The Discover Uni snapshot describes 2026/27 entry. Separately cited provider examples may cover later entry years. Recheck offerings with the provider.
availability.scope: First degrees and integrated masters, full-time and part-time; exact HECoS codes. Provider examples are separately curated subject assignments.
availability.meaning: Evidence a subject is represented in recorded courses; not a live availability or vacancies check. A coded subject can be part of a joint course.
availability.missingMeaning: No course evidence in these sources, not proof that no course exists.

admissions.interpretation: A course example applies only to its named provider and course. An unresearched subject has no verified example in this sample. No HECoS-wide A-level requirement is inferred.
admissions.requiredGroupsSemantics: AND between groups; OR within oneOf; each group must use a distinct A-level subject. Each alternativeRoutes item is a separate published or conditional path with its own grades, subject groups, and possibly otherQualificationGroups. Provider-defined category labels require human review. minGrade is a subject-specific floor only when stated. Selection requirements and other conditions still apply.
admissions.subjectAggregateSemantics: requiredBySomeCourses lists an A-level only when at least one cited course includes it in every valid combination of every coded route. It is not a HECoS-wide or universal requirement. requiredSubjectEvidence names those courses; routeSpecificRequiredSubjectEvidence names requirements applying only to particular coded routes; alternativeSubjectGroups preserves course-specific OR choices separately. Empty requiredGroups is explicit_none only if the provider expressly states no specific A-level subjects; otherwise it is not_named_on_source.
admissions.sourceNotes: Source URLs are university admissions pages or provider-supplied 2027 listings on UCAS. Oxford summary rows are course-specific, but applicants must check the full course page before applying.
admissions.subjectMatchBasis: HECoS links are our curated title/subject assignments; providers did not publish these codes for the sampled courses.
